title: A Conference Talk
instructions: Listen carefully. Choose the option that best matches what is said or implied.

audio.description: A Conference Talk. Locally generated synthetic English speech.

transcript.text: The speaker was supposed to discuss the results of a recent study, but she began by describing the mistakes her team had made. At first this seemed unusual. Later, however, it became clear that those mistakes had led to a more reliable research method. The audience asked more questions about the process than about the final findings.

questions.prompt: What was unusual about the introduction?
options: It was given by a different speaker
It focused on the team’s mistakes
It began with the final results
